configuration: Synthetic account/catalog/ranking fixtures with real public cover bytes when ANIME_QA_COVERS is supplied. No live login or personal-data writes.

checks.name: automatic Watch next loads five covers without a mood request
opening a five-card deck needs no new request
left swipe advances immediately and Undo restores the cached card
rapid visible Pass actions consume the existing deck without blocking the next card
right swipe saves the lead pick and Undo restores it
viewing notes persist and are searchable within the owner’s library
another account cannot read or edit the owner’s notes
search rows, long titles and broken covers stay within their frames at every target size
phone home, deck and notes have loaded art and no document overflow
a long recommendation reason expands the card without overlapping its controls
